title: Gün Batarken
author: Ercüment Ekrem Talu
description:
Set against the final years of a collapsing empire, As the Sun Sets follows an idealistic soldier serving in the provinces as the turmoil of his age gradually strips him of his principles. Surrounded by pressure to embrace a life of indulgence, he watches honesty, integrity and morality give way to corruption: while impoverished young men sacrifice their lives on the front, newly rich war profiteers pursue luxury without conscience, and those determined to earn an honest living are condemned to a precarious existence. In this incisive novel, the setting sun becomes a powerful metaphor for both the fall of an empire and the defeat of the values upon which it once claimed to stand.

Kafka Kitap brings this major work by Ercüment Ekrem Talû to contemporary readers in the modern Turkish alphabet, alongside two other titles by the author, The Moderns (Asriler) and The Sea Lion (Gemi Arslanı).
